R0_OralContraceptiveStatus.title: Whether the participant was using oral contraceptives at baseline
R0_OralContraceptiveStatus.x-derivation: Derived from pill episodes and age at entry. CURRENT (2) if any ContracepPill episode covers age at entry (StartAge ≤ AgeEntry ≤ StopAge) or if CurrentUse=1 on any episode; FORMER (1) if any prior use but no episode covers entry; NEVER (0) if no pill use. Null if insufficient info. Derived from: R0_ContracepPillUse, R0_ContracepPill_StartAge, R0_ContracepPill_StopAge, R0_ContracepPill_CurrentUse, AgeEntry

R0_AgeStartedOC.title: Age first used oral contraceptives
R0_AgeStartedOC.x-derivation: Earliest start age across ContracepPill episodes. Null if never used or no valid start ages. Derived from: R0_ContracepPill_StartAge

R0_AgeLastUsedOC.title: Age last used oral contraceptives
R0_AgeLastUsedOC.x-derivation: For former users, latest stop age across ContracepPill episodes that end on/before entry; for current, take age at entry, or never, null. Derived from: R0_ContracepPill_StopAge, AgeEntry

R0_OCLength.title: Total duration of oral contraceptive use (years)
R0_OCLength.x-derivation: Merge overlapping ContracepPill episodes; sum (min(StopAge, AgeEntry) - StartAge) across merged spans, floor negatives at 0; treat ongoing episodes (missing StopAge or CurrentUse=1) as ending at AgeEntry. Round to 1 dp. Null if insufficient info; 0 if never used. Derived from: R0_ContracepPill_StartAge, R0_ContracepPill_StopAge, R0_ContracepPill_CurrentUse, AgeEntry
